title: Soboro Miao ying Reskin pack 1.0.0
author: SOBORO_Bang
description:
Before reading this, please consider that my English is not very good.

This mod is a replacement for miao ying's head modeling in lazylcarus. It requires lazylcarus' default mod pack, you only need to replace the stage pack.

The previous mods, except Stage, must be obtained in advance from lazylcarus's mod file.

Mod Arrangement Order (same as lazylcarus' mode arrangement order)

Soboro_Miao.pack

li_miaoying_scale_soboro_st1.pack

li_miaoying_fishnet_soboro_st2.pack

li_miaoying_ballet_soboro_st3.pack

li_miaoying_bare_soboro_st4.pack

li_miaoying_corset_soboro_st5.pack

li_miaoying_plug_soboro_st6.pack

Let me explain the installation further.

If you already have lazy mods installed, you just need to turn off lazy's stagepack and turn on mine (in this order)

If this is your first time installing lazy mod, you'll need to uninstall everything except the stage pack from lazy, and then install stage by itself.

If you find any bugs, please talk to me on the discord channel of lazylcarus.
